pinned_function_sha256._rule: sha256 of the utf-8 source text of each function (ast.get_source_segment of the file, LF). A mismatch means the runtime semantics this contract compares changed: re-draft before Integration relies on it. The seven candidate functions equal the signed family contract pins.

signed_contracts._rule: sha256 of the committed bytes at 2204e35 (LF)

replay_definition.semantics: the SIGNED repro contract semantics block, keys cited per field (frame_and_warmup, indicators, entry_signal, signal_exit, pending_and_fill, sizing, per_bar_management_order, intrabar_path, time_exit, exit_accounting, stats), F01 cell only
replay_definition.input_frames: the exact closed 4h candles the runtime computed its signals from, per symbol (recorded with sha256 in the evidence frames_manifest), never a separately downloaded series
replay_definition.account: the replay keeps its own single-cell account ($500, share 1.0, 1 %, 10x, 8 % halt) so its trade list is self-contained; absolute size fields are NOT-COMPARABLE (P15)
replay_definition.executor: OQ7 (6512712537): the Evidence lane (Cowork) independently runs the replay and OWNS verdict.json; Build supplies immutable, sha256-hashed runtime extracts only and never self-verdicts. No import of Build runtime modules (the repro forbidden list applies)
replay_definition.trade_set_rule: OQ4 (6512712537), narrowed: the runtime and replay trade sets on (symbol, entry bar, side) must match. A runtime refusal whose reason is in causal_window.registered_refusal_prefixes and was LOGGED AT THAT DECISION explains that exact decision only. Downstream replay-only entries are excluded only inside the explicitly listed causal window it opens, which closes when runtime and replay are both flat for the candidate. No open-ended same-symbol exemption and no post-hoc reason. Raw signals, decision bars and pre-gate counts (P01-P05) stay MUST-MATCH throughout, inside a window too. Any other divergence is PARITY-FAIL. Algorithm and test vectors: causal_window. N1 (6512978555): inside an ALREADY-open window a runtime-only entry is LISTED only with a same-decision replay candidate / family-cap refusal, matching raw signal + decision bar and a replay slot directly traceable to the window's explained refusal (predecessor / window id recorded); every other runtime-only entry is PARITY-FAIL. A window still open at canary end makes the verdict INCONCLUSIVE (never PARITY-PASS); never extend risk / duration or force-close to manufacture closure.
replay_definition.scoring_start: OQ2 (6512712537): >= 250 older closed 4h bars may seed the indicators but are WARM-UP ONLY and never scored. The authorization / start timestamp is frozen (preflight.json) before any scored bar is read. Scoring starts at the first fully closed 4h decision bar after BOTH the authorization and a successful preflight. Post-2026-09-28 bars may be read for this forward PAPER run only; never to retune or retroactively select the candidate.

failure_injections.name: restart mid-position
failure_injections.inject: open a C-F01 lot through the cycle, persist settings + state, construct a new Engine on the same data dir with the same exchange (stop still resting)
failure_injections.expected: the lot reloads with its sleeve, stop and stop id unchanged; a same-coin signal is refused "already in a trade on this coin"; the next lx=True cycle closes it as exit_signal; C-F02 stays OFF

failure_injections.name: pending-cost row older than 6 h
failure_injections.inject: a C-F01 closed row whose costs stay pending; guard at close + 21599 s and + 21600 s (C-F02 OFF)
failure_injections.expected: no disable before 6 h; at 6 h candidate_guard switches C-F01 off with "accounting: ..."; C-F02 stays OFF and is not reported; open lots keep stop and management

failure_injections.name: evicted pending row behind > 3000 closes + restart
failure_injections.inject: a real C-F01 close with pending costs, 3000 newer rows, one more real close (eviction), save, restart
failure_injections.expected: the durable index still holds the row; the guard disables the family at close + 6 h on the stored close time; only settlement clears it

failure_injections.name: lost protection (restoring / owner_check)
failure_injections.inject: an open C-F01 lot gets stop_miss with stop_miss_why checking, then restoring / owner_check
failure_injections.expected: checking: no disable; restoring / owner_check: C-F01 switched off ("protection: <sym> stop <why>"); the guard never closes the lot, its stop stays, and it is still exited by its signal

failure_injections.name: family disable: drift / family order / symbol order / guard error
failure_injections.inject: card drift on any CANDIDATE_CARD field; both members enabled out of order; a reordered CAND_FIXED18; an exception inside the guard
failure_injections.expected: every enabled member switched off in the same pass with the named reason; only Integration re-enables; the disabled state survives a restart

canary.authorization_rule: execution needs a separate Integration (Codex) comment id recorded here by Integration; this contract alone authorizes nothing. The authorization / start timestamp is frozen in preflight.json before any scored bar is read (OQ2)
canary.environment: PAPER / Binance Futures testnet only; never mainnet, never MODE / LIVE_CONFIRM changes

preconditions.rule: OQ3 candidate-flat start: C-F01 and C-F02 have no lot and no pending, resting, unconfirmed or deferred entry. A pre-canary C-F01 lot is never imported into scoring
OQ3: other PAPER slots may stay open only if captured in preflight.json (symbol, slot, side); their isolation / halt effects are listed under P08 / P09 / P10
candidate_guard green: no drift / protection / accounting / order trigger for C-F01; state["candidate_disabled"] has no unresolved C-F01 entry, or Integration cleared it
the C-F01 slot equals its frozen card (candidate_drift == [])
OQ5: C-F01 governor and Kelly sizing multipliers == 1.0 (governor_mult, kelly_mult) without changing any global PAPER setting
OQ5: C-F01 control sizing multiplier (ctrl long_factor) == 1.0 without changing any global PAPER setting

OQ5: ENTRY_ORDER market and MAX_LEVERAGE 10 required; the existing AI_FILTER and FEE_EDGE_GATE values are RECORDED in preflight.json and never switched off under this contract (their refusals are P10 LISTED)
the pinned function sha256s of this contract equal the running build; the running head SHA is recorded
the Integration authorization comment id is recorded in canary.authorization_comment_id, and the authorization / start timestamp is frozen before any scored bar is read

stop_conditions.rule: candidate_guard disables C-F01 for any reason (drift, protection, accounting, family order, guard_error)
any MUST-MATCH parity field outside tolerance (including P13 C-F02 activity)
a C-F01 lot loses protection: stop_miss_why restoring or owner_check (also S1)
a C-F01 closed row has costs pending >= 21600 s (also S1)
cumulative measured C-F01 net R drawdown from the canary peak reaches 4.0 R (OQ1)
the first of 30 calendar days or 8 closed C-F01 trades is reached (normal end, OQ1)
any mainnet / live / credential event, MODE change, or an environment that cannot be confirmed as testnet

rollback: R1 Integration (only) disables new C-F01 entries (slot enabled = false through settings); Build and Evidence never edit settings
R2 OQ8 (6512712537): already-open C-F01 PAPER lots are NOT closed by the rollback: they keep confirmed exchange protection and normal signal / stop management until they exit
R2b Integration force-closes only for: unknown account state, lost / unrestorable protection, environment uncertainty, or a separately recorded safety decision
R3 confirm after the next cycle: no new C-F01 entry, every open C-F01 lot has a confirmed stop (no stop_miss), C-F02 still OFF
R4 publish the runtime extracts with the stop condition id; Cowork publishes verdict.json; record the candidate_disabled reason if the guard fired

causal_window.status: specified algorithm (offline); implemented only as a reference helper in tests/test_factory_f01_parity_01_contract.py, never in engine/runtime code
causal_window.input: steps ordered by decision bar: {bar, events: [...], rt_flat_after, rp_flat_after}; rt_flat_after / rp_flat_after = the candidate (C-F01) has no lot, pending, resting, unconfirmed or deferred entry on that side after the step

event_types.match: runtime and replay agree on this decision
event_types.pre_gate_mismatch: raw signal, decision bar or pre-gate count differs (P01-P05)
event_types.rt_refused_rp_entered: runtime refused (reason, logged_at_decision), the replay entered at the same decision
event_types.rp_only_entry: a replay entry with no runtime decision counterpart refused for a registered reason at that decision
event_types.rt_only_entry: a runtime entry the replay does not have. Evidence fields (6513165844, no free booleans): pre_gate = {P01..P05: {rt, rp}} (match is COMPUTED: P01 / P02 / P03 / P05 equal, P04 rel 1e-9); rp_refusal_reason = the exact replay refusal text at that decision; rp_check_bar = the bar the replay applied its cap (fill check); rp_state = {open: [replay entry keys counted toward the cap at rp_check_bar], cap_count}; predecessor = {key: [explained refusal decision bar, symbol], window_id, t_in, t_out (null while open)}

algorithm: 2 for each step in bar order, for each event:

rt_refused_rp_entered -> PASS only if reason starts with a registered prefix AND logged_at_decision is true (else PARITY-FAIL: unregistered or post-hoc); it opens a window at this bar if none is open; the decision is listed as explained
rp_only_entry -> excluded (listed) only while a window is open; otherwise PARITY-FAIL

rt_only_entry -> N1 mirror capacity (6512978555, made evidence-derived by 6513165844): LISTED / excluded ONLY when ALL hold: (1) a window is ALREADY open and predecessor.window_id is its id; (2) predecessor.key is an explained refusal of THAT window; (3) pre_gate P01..P05 all present and equal (computed); (4) rp_refusal_reason is EXACTLY one of mirror_cap_reasons; (5) predecessor.t_in <= rp_check_bar and (t_out is null or t_out >= rp_check_bar) - a lot exiting ON the check bar still occupies its slot (signed same-bar convention, repro per_bar_management_order step 2 before step 3); (6) predecessor.key is in rp_state.open and rp_state.cap_count == len(rp_state.open) >= CANDIDATE_MAX_POS (4). Listed as [bar, symbol, "mirror_cap", window id, predecessor bar, predecessor symbol]. Anything else -> PARITY-FAIL
3 after the step: if a window is open and rt_flat_after and rp_flat_after -> close it at this bar

4 end (ruling 6512978555): a window still open (runtime / replay not resynchronized to candidate-flat) -> INCONCLUSIVE with the open window(s) listed (close null): never PARITY-PASS and not a defect PARITY-FAIL; otherwise PASS with the windows and exclusions
5 never extend canary risk or duration, and never force-close, to manufacture a window closure
registered_refusal_prefixes: leverage cap reached for this slot
an earlier entry on this coin/side is not confirmed yet
could not set leverage/margin on Binance
entry not sent: its write-ahead record
an open trade on this coin is waiting for its stop
causal_window.registered_prefix_rule: every prefix is literal engine.py refusal text (P08 / P09 / P10); a reason outside this list never explains a divergence
mirror_cap_reasons: candidate family trend_long: 4 open (one shared cap of 4)

causal_window.window_ids: W1, W2, ... in the order windows open

>= 250 older closed 4h bars are unscored warm-up only; the authorization / start timestamp is frozen before scored bars are read; scoring starts at the first fully closed 4h decision bar after both authorization and a successful preflight; post-2026-09-28 bars only for this forward PAPER run, never for retuning or selection

candidate-flat start (no C-F01 / C-F02 lot or pending / resting / unconfirmed / deferred entry); other PAPER slots open only if captured in preflight with their isolation / halt effects listed; never import a pre-canary C-F01 lot into scoring

a logged registered refusal explains that exact decision only; downstream replay-only trades excluded only inside an explicitly listed causal window ending when both sides are flat for the candidate; no open-ended same-symbol exemption, no post-hoc reason; raw signals, decision bars and pre-gate counts stay MUST-MATCH; unexplained divergence is PARITY-FAIL

no global PAPER setting changes; C-F01 governor / Kelly / control multipliers = 1.0, market entry, 10x cap; existing AI and fee-gate values recorded at preflight and never switched off, their refusals P10 LISTED; pre-gate signal parity mandatory; P14 uses the frozen neutral multipliers; P18 reports actual cap effects
